about: ​Designed to meet the connectivity demands of modern surveillance and SMB networks, the HR200P-16T2MS-200 combines high-performance Gigabit switching with reliable PoE power delivery. It features 16 Gigabit PoE ports, dual 2.5G SFP uplinks, and a 185W PoE budget, supporting IEEE 802.3af/at and up to 60W HiPoE on ports 1–2.
